snippet.title: Grindworm - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Grindworm is a short horror game where you're buried alive in a collapsed underground mine, and your only hope for survival is an old mining machine. Grindworm is built around isolation, dread, and the slow erosion of reality. Check out the tense Grindworm announcement trailer. Grindworm will be available on PC.
